headings.style: Bold, extended, tracking-tighter, fluid scaling (up to text-6xl for hero). NEVER center-align.

data_logistics.style: Uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-sm. Used for time, date, venue, and QR pass IDs.

visual_enhancers.marquees: Kinetic typographic marquees (infinite scroll) for artist/event lineups. Use text-8xl outline text for background texture.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Crystal glass (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10) for sticky headers and floating scanner controls.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on dark backgrounds to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: Expose the skeleton on the admin dashboard. 1px border-white/10 on grid items.

layouts.marketing_landing: Full-bleed hero with bg-black/50 overlay over the crowd image. Asymmetrical Bento grid for event highlights. Generous spacing (py-24, gap-12).
layouts.registration_flow: Stepped sections. Do not overwhelm with forms. Floating persistent 'Complete Payment' CTA at the bottom.
layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
layouts.scanner_app: Mobile-first. Full-screen camera viewport. Glassmorphic bottom sheet for scan results (Valid/Duplicate/Invalid).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Primary CTA must use brand_primary (Yellow) with pure black text for contrast. Hover: -translate-y-1 with shadow-lg.
components.cards: Flat solid background (#121212), 1px border-white/10, no ambient shadow in dark mode. Sharp or max rounded-lg.
components.forms: Use pure Tailwind inputs. bg-black/50, border-white/10, text-white. Focus state: ring-2 ring-brand_primary outline-none.
components.qr_pass: Neumorphic or glowing technical card. Prominent QR code on #FFFFFF background (for scannability), surrounded by dark festival branding.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all clickable elements (-translate-y-1 or brightness increase).
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for grid items. Do NOT use universal 'transition: all'. Explicitly transition transform and opacity.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over brand_primary is #000000. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus indicators on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button').

image_urls.description: High energy youth concert crowd. Use as full-bleed hero background with bg-black/50 overlay.
Visual representation of the digital QR pass for the registration success page.
Contextual image for the admin/scanner feature highlight.

instructions_to_main_agent: Since the stack is PHP CodeIgniter 4, you MUST construct the UI using standard HTML/PHP views (.php) and pure Tailwind CSS classes.
DO NOT attempt to use React components (.jsx/.tsx) or Shadcn-React. Implement interactivity using vanilla JavaScript (.js) or Alpine.js.
For the EaseBuzz payment flow, ensure the checkout form reflects raw HTML functionality with precise Tailwind styling to look premium.
For the QR Scanner, integrate a vanilla JS library like html5-qrcode within the CI4 view.
Replicate the Shadcn aesthetic (crisp borders, clean inputs, minimal shadows) using raw Tailwind utility classes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids and heavy left-alignment for typography.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center globally.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Heroicons SVGs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background is strictly forbidden.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
